name: Generate weekly client reports from a config sheet with Google Sheets, Meta Ads, Google Ads, GA4 and OpenAI

parameters.content:
# Weekly client reports — one sheet drives every client, source and send

```
┌────────┐──▶┌────────┐──▶┌───────┐──▶┌───────────┐──▶┌────────┐──▶┌────────┐
│ config │──▶│ expand │──▶│ fetch │──▶│ normalize │──▶│ deltas │──▶│ dedupe │
└────────┘──▶└────────┘──▶└───────┘──▶└───────────┘──▶└────────┘──▶└───┬────┘
                                                                       │
             ┌────────┐◀──┌────────┐◀──┌───────┐◀──┌────────┐◀──┌──────▼────┐
             │ digest │◀──│ ledger │◀──│ sinks │◀──│ render │◀──│ narrative │
             └────────┘◀──└────────┘◀──└───────┘◀──└────────┘◀──└───────────┘
```

**Who it's for:** agencies and freelancers who write the same per-client performance report every week.

**How it works:** every Monday the workflow reads a `config` tab — one row per client, one column per data source (`src_meta_ads`, `src_google_ads`, `src_ga4`) and per delivery sink (`sink_gmail`, `sink_slack`), plus per-client `delivery_mode` (`send`/`draft`), brand cells (`brand_name`, `brand_color`, `brand_logo_url`) and `alert_threshold_pct`. Enabled sources are fetched and normalized into one metric contract; a Code node computes week-over-week deltas deterministically (the AI never does math) and flags metrics whose |delta| crosses the client's threshold; the AI writes the prose around the precomputed table; the report renders as a per-client branded HTML email — sent, or filed as a Gmail draft for owner review — and/or posts to the client's Slack channel, then logged to a `reports` tab keyed `client_id+ISO week` so re-runs in the same week are skipped as duplicates. Every run ends with one digest emailed to the operator.

**Setup:** run the orange SETUP lane once to create the workbook, paste the printed `spreadsheet_id` into **Workflow Config**, attach credentials (Gmail + Sheets + OpenAI nodes, plus a Header Auth / Custom Auth credential on each HTTP fetch/post node — API tokens never live in the artifact or in env vars), set your address in **Operator email**, fill the `config` tab, activate. **Test workflow** runs a four-client demo with zero credentials.

**Contract** — side_effects: Gmail sends/drafts, Slack posts, `reports`-tab upserts, one operator digest email per run. rollback: set `enabled` to `no` in the row, or deactivate the workflow; delete the `reports` row to allow a re-send.

## 1 — Weekly engine
Schedule → config → dedupe → AI narrative → render → sinks → ledger → digest.

## 2 — Source adapters
Meta / Google Ads / GA4. Live gate picks real fetch or demo fixture; dock sends a skipped-source alert.

## 3 — Sinks
Gmail send-or-draft and Slack post, both live-gated. Dock reports skipped sinks.

## 4 — Demo lane
Manual trigger + fixture config — runs the whole flow with zero credentials.

## 5 — Error lane
On workflow error, email the operator.

## 6 — Setup lane
Run once: creates the Google Sheet workbook and seeds config + ledger tabs.

nodes.notes: Demo mirror — records what the Gmail send would have done.

nodes.name: Post report to Slack
nodes.notes: chat.postMessage to the per-client channel from the config row. Attach a Header Auth credential: name 'Authorization', value 'Bearer <bot token>' (chat:write scope).

nodes.name: Slack delivered?
nodes.notes: chat.postMessage returns ok:false at HTTP 200 — only ok===true counts as delivered; ok:false routes to the sink-alert branch with the API error string.

parameters.jsCode:
const req = $('Fan out sinks').item.json;
return { json: { status: 'sink-ok', sink: 'slack', dedupe_key: req.dedupe_key, client_id: req.client_id, to: req.to, flag_count: req.flag_count || 0, flags: req.flags || [], live: true } };

nodes.name: Demo Slack sink
nodes.notes: Demo mirror — records what the Slack post would have done.

nodes.name: Sink extension dock
nodes.notes: Attach point for new sink adapters.

nodes.name: Compose sink alert
nodes.notes: Turns a failed send or ledger write into a failure alert for the digest.

nodes.name: Merge sends
nodes.notes: append — one wave of sink results per run.

nodes.name: Collapse sends
nodes.notes: One 'reported' item per delivered report — the ledger write key.

nodes.name: Record report?
nodes.notes: Live reports upsert the ledger; demo and skips pass to the digest merge.

nodes.name: Record report
nodes.notes: appendOrUpdate on dedupe_key — a retried write updates the same row, never a duplicate.

nodes.name: Merge run
nodes.notes: append — single wave in front of the digest (the A6.1 rule: merge first, digest once).

nodes.name: Run digest
nodes.notes: One digest item — status 'digest', needs_attention lists every alert; 'live' is true only when the wave came from the sheet (demo runs carry live:false).

nodes.name: Digest is live?
nodes.notes: Same live-gate pattern as the sink branches — demo digests (live:false) end here and never reach Gmail.

nodes.name: Format digest email
nodes.notes: Builds the digest mail from the Run digest item; silent when no digest exists (error-triggered executions).

nodes.name: Email operator: run digest
nodes.notes: One run summary per live run. No error output on purpose — a failed digest mail fails the execution and the error lane reports it (routing it back to Merge run would loop).

nodes.name: Create report workbook
nodes.notes: One call creates the workbook with both tabs.

nodes.name: Seed tabs
nodes.notes: Seed keys are the schema — they become the tab headers.

nodes.name: Print sheet id + next step
nodes.notes: The id to paste into Workflow Config.
